mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations fall, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 105.0), manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and lower earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs per month indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 200,000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger a more aggressive monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to their 12-month moving averages indicate a weakening demand environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate below 1.0% annualized), weak demand signals from residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) amplify the risk of a recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 1.0% and both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
